verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim is documented as integrating into existing testing and validation pipelines, supporting software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop evaluation, and validating ROS 2 stacks. Headless operation, pip-installable packages and ROS 2 services for loading worlds and stepping simulations make scripted, CI-style simulation runs plausible. However, the pack never describes CI integration or a regression-test framework, so the developer must assemble the CI harness themselves. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g., container or runner guidance), built-in regression-test tooling or pass/fail assertions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sim-based CI testing.
